caveats.draws: A draw is rarely the single likeliest result, so it is rarely the pick - even though about a quarter of matches end level. Its chance is always shown.
caveats.model: The pick is the betting market's chances, recalibrated on earlier seasons: across 2016-2025 the model alone picked 53.3% of results and the market 54.1%, and blending the model in added nothing the market did not already know. The model's own chances are shown beside each pick, labelled. Betting the model where it disagreed with the price did not make money. Treat a pick as an opinion with a measured hit rate, not an edge.
caveats.news: The model does not read team news - injuries, suspensions, rotation. The betting market does, which is part of why the pick leans on it.
caveats.rating: The model rates each club's attack and defence from its goals, shots on target and shots, weighted toward recent matches; a promoted club carries its rating up with a measured step. The rating is the model's own view - the pick on each match is the market's chances, recalibrated, because the market forecasts better.
caveats.rating_short: The goal difference a match each club would expect against an average club of its league on a neutral pitch, by the model's ratings, strongest first.
